cards.card_text: He strikes the socket of Jacob's hip He shoves Jacob into the stream He lets go and slips off into the dark
cards.verse_text: When the man saw that he could not overpower Jacob, he struck the socket of Jacob’s hip and dislocated it as they wrestled.
cards.snippet: …the man saw that he could not overpower Jacob, he struck the socket of Jacob’s hip and dislocated it as they wrestled.

cards.card_text: When this was written, the Israelites still didn't eat the tendon attached to the socket of the hip.
cards.verse_text: Therefore to this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon attached to the socket of the hip, because the socket of Jacob’s hip was struck near that tendon.
cards.snippet: …this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon attached to the socket of the hip, because the socket of Jacob’s hip was struck near…

cards.card_text: Their flesh will rot while they stand on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.
cards.verse_text: And this will be the plague with which the LORD strikes all the peoples who have warred against Jerusalem: Their flesh will rot while they stand on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.
cards.snippet: …while they stand on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.
